name: SURPLUS

location.venue_or_area: Darlinghurst, 21 venues incl. National Art School, Oxford Art Factory, Burton Street marketplace

instagram.bio:
October 16-18, 2026
Darlinghurst, Eora/Sydney, Australia 
Presented by @supplystore and @nsw

attendance.note: Organiser-reported '15,000+' for the 2025 first edition, across 21 venues and 50 activations with 110 partners. 2026 figure not yet published.

audience.psychographics: Sydney streetwear, sneaker, club and independent publishing communities in Supply Store's orbit; creative industry, style-led, inner-city.

partnership_contact.named_person: Crimson at Leaf Comms (press and media enquiries: crimson@leafcomms.com)

ticket_price.note: Most events free and open to the public. Headline shows (e.g. Rainbow Disco Club at National Art School) ticketed via Humanitix. Marketplace free.

vibe.rationale: Benchmark event: retailer-curated, community-first, multi-venue, brand-friendly without feeling corporate.

fit_notes: Benchmark. Presenting slot held by Nike Sportswear, so High Ground would need a non-competing category role (e.g. a lounge, wellness or recovery space, or a program strand) rather than headline billing.

sources.note: Humanitix host page lists 17 to 19 Oct; most sources say 16 to 18 Oct.
